bibl.title: Royal or Divine? Female Heads in the Edfu Hoard.
bibl.seg: Branko van Oppen de Ruiter & Catharine C. Lorber, Royal or Divine? Female Heads in the Edfu Hoard.
bibl.note: Hoard of some 800 clay seal impressions dating to the second half of the Ptolemaic period found over a century ago in a vessel in (or near) the Horus temple at Edfu [now in Toronto at the Royal Ontario Museum and in Amsterdam at the Allard Pierson Museum]. - I. Divine and/or royal attributes. - II. Identifications: Cleopatra I; - Cleopatra II; - Cleopatra III. - Conclusion.
